classification.difficultyReason: Read the shaded bounds and apply the taught definite-integral formula using polynomial or fractional-power antiderivatives. Each region stays above the axis, so no splitting or sign adjustment is required.

content.prompt: Find the area of each shaded region below by evaluating the appropriate integral.
